meta.title: Panel Pins
meta.description: A Panels launcher that groups global panel rows and third-party plugin entry rows into one menu (clicks the original buttons, collapsible per-group fold memory, badge counts both, whitelist keeps entries in the sidebar, Ctrl+K command palette); pin/unpin rows in the More menu; right-click any sidebar row for quick management (including Move to front); sidebar rows support drag-to-reorder (a blue line marks the insert position; the right-click Move-to-front is the touch fallback); icon-only panel-row mode; a toggleable compact-footer patch with granular sub-toggles. The Settings column offers live toggles, height sliders, whitelist editing, pin management (drag-to-reorder top pins) and settings export/import via clipboard, settings file AND drag-drop. Bottom entries stay in place. All state survives restarts.
